guard: loadMeshes refuses a registry record this build cannot use, naming the file, instead of handing the renderer a record that crashes it
why: A parseable record missing server/mode reached listMeshes, whose width() helper pads m.server
and m.mode, and `cotal meshes` died with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"
while `cotal status` printed literal `undefined` columns. Reproduced on a disposable COTAL_HOME
with one well-formed control record plus the three-field record from the report.
loadMeshes now validates each parsed document (assertMeshEntryShape) and refuses by name. The
mutations cover both halves of the guard: reverting the shape check returns to the skip-everything
posture (red on the missing-fields cell), and reverting the parse guard to a skip returns to the
old silent-skip behavior (red on the does-not-parse cell). A third mutation proves the enum check
is load-bearing: without it a record with an unknown mode loads and the cell named for it greens.

mutations.name: the shape check is reverted to the old skip
mutations.expectRed: a record missing required fields refuses naming the file and the fields
mutations.cell: a record missing required fields refuses naming the file and the fields

mutations.name: a file that does not parse is skipped again
mutations.find: throw new Error(`${file} does not parse as a mesh record (${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}) - restore it from backup or remove it`);
mutations.expectRed: a registry file that does not parse refuses naming the file (no silent skip)
mutations.cell: a registry file that does not parse refuses naming the file (no silent skip)

mutations.name: the mode enum check is removed
mutations.find:
if (entry.mode !== "auth" && entry.mode !== "open" && entry.mode !== "user")
    throw new Error(`${file} is not a usable mesh record: mode "${entry.mode}" is not one of auth, open, user - restore the record or remove it`);
mutations.expectRed: a record with a mode this build does not know refuses naming the file
mutations.cell: a record with a mode this build does not know refuses naming the file
